workers.name: Dana
workers.description: Experienced grill cook who can also prepare toppings, though more slowly than the prep specialist.

profile.background: Lead line cook with twelve years behind a flat-top, most of them in high-volume burger joints. Runs the grill and helps on toppings when the board backs up.
strengths: Starts the slowest, most deadline-critical patties first
Keeps the flat-top busy without letting cooked patties sit
watch_outs: Preps lettuce at 1.5x, so toppings go to Sam when he is free
The only full-time grill cook; if Dana steps away, Jordan has to cover

workers.name: Sam
workers.description: Preparation specialist who prepares toppings and can assemble burgers.

profile.background: Came up through a sandwich shop before moving to the burger line. Owns mise en place and assembles burgers once the toppings are ready.
strengths: Keeps the line fed with ready toppings
Fills gaps instead of duplicating someone else's work
watch_outs: Not trained on the grill or fryer, so can't cover either

workers.name: Riley
workers.description: Runs the fryer and packs finished orders.

profile.background: Two years on the fryer and the pass. Likes short, repeatable tasks and pushes nearly finished orders out the door.
strengths: Keeps fries coming on a one-basket fryer
Packs finished orders before food goes cold
watch_outs: Can't grill, prep, assemble, or verify; idle when the fryer and packing are clear

workers.name: Jordan
workers.description: Assembles, packs, and verifies orders for pickup. Cross-trained as the backup grill cook.

profile.background: Ran the pass at a busy diner for five years. Assembles, packs, and verifies every order, and is cross-trained as the backup grill cook.
strengths: Watches the whole board and calls out stuck orders
The only worker who can verify orders, and the grill backup
watch_outs: Covering the grill leaves no one to verify, so pickups queue up
